title: Gaussian assignment
statement: Let $r$ be a natural number, let $V$ be a finite set with decidable equality, and suppose $V$ is encodable. For an instance of the maximum linear constraint template with variables in $V$, its Gaussian assignment is the function from $V$ to the binary field obtained by applying the row-solving operation to the instance's linear rows.
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the instance's linear rows or the row-solving operation, so their precise mathematical meaning cannot be rendered from the given material.
